item.title: Local school officials testify about need for cyber charter school reform
item.description: Cyber charter school students have lower academic outcomes, even as districts funnel more taxpayer dollars into them, public school officials in Lackawanna and Luzerne counties say.

item.title: HS ROUNDUP: Pittston Area takes down rival Wyoming Area
item.description: Pittston Area girls basketball picked up the win over its local rival Monday night. Bella Dessoye led a balanced Pittston Area scoring attack with a game-high 15 points in a 50-27 victory over Wyoming Area on Monday night at Pittston Area. Julia Long scored seven points for the Patriots, while Leah Drozginski, Giuliana Latona and Arianna McGarry each scored six. Jailynn Park and Londyn Sobeck each scored nine points for Wyoming Area. item.title: LOCAL OLYMPICS CONNECTIONS: Dallas native Radzinski trainer for U.S. Olympic ski team
item.description: A Dallas Borough native is in Italy this week to help U.S. Olympic athletes prevent injuries, manage the ones they do suffer and provide treatment as they compete to bring home the gold.

item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Quron Drayton, Holy Redeemer basketball
item.description: With the opportunity to clinch a spot in the Wyoming Valley Conference tournament and finish in sole possession of second place in Division 2, Quron Drayton provided the game-winning shot to lift Holy Redeemer to a one-point win Saturday afternoon. Drayton’s bucket gave the Royals a 37-36 victory and clinched the No. 2 seed in Division 2.
